subject: BlueOcean onboarding — PO routing, spend band and line ownership
messages:
From: Claire Burns <claire@blueocean.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: BlueOcean onboarding — provisional PO request
Attachments: BlueOcean_onboarding_form_v1.pdf (application/pdf)

Hi Markus / Monica,

Thanks for the quick onboarding flow last week. Attached is our completed onboarding form (v1). We need a provisional PO/ponum to start ingesting usage for November — billing team is asking for a PO token to map to our spend band.

Requested spend cap: $45,000/mo (we expect to ramp). Line items in the form map to two SKUs: BLA-API-REG and BLA-EMB-STD — please let us know if the ledger codes need any changes.

Can you confirm ETA for a provisional PO and whether the requested spend cap needs approval?

Thanks,
Claire Burns
Head of Finance, BlueOcean AI
claire@blueocean.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.inference.com>
To: Claire Burns <claire@blueocean.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BlueOcean onboarding — provisional PO request

Claire — thanks and welcome. Quick read of the form: two issues before procurement can issue a provisional PO token.

1) Missing tax / entity identifier — procurement requires the vendor tax ID (or VAT) to generate the ponum. The onboarding form has a blank in that field. Please attach the vendor W9 or equivalent.

2) Line item SKU mismatch — your form lists BLA-EMB-STD but our catalog maps the embedding SKU to EMB-L1 (catalog id EMB-L1-v2). If you prefer to keep your internal names that's fine, but we need a one-to-one map to our ledger SKUs so spend is attributed correctly.

Monica / Connor — can procurement provision a temporary PO with a conservative spend band while BlueOcean supplies the W9 and confirms SKU mapping? If yes, please also provide the temporary ponum and a note of the spend cap we should enforce (billing routing).

Action items:
- Claire: attach W9 + updated onboarding form with SKU mapping (ASAP)
- Monica: confirm whether we can issue a provisional PO under a soft-spend cap and what that cap should be
- Connor: once provisional ponum issued, can you patch the ledger to accept the temporary mapping and mark the line ownership for follow-up?

Markus
Director, Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference.com>
To: Claire Burns <claire@blueocean.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.inference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 13:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BlueOcean onboarding — provisional PO request
Attachments: ponum_temporary_9203.txt (text/plain), ponum_update_instructions.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats)

Hi Claire — thanks for the form. A couple notes from procurement:

• Tax ID: procurement requires the W9 or certificate of incorporation. Please send the document to finance@redwood.inference.com and cc me.

• Provisional PO: I can provision a temporary PO token while we validate tax docs and SKU mapping. I am issuing temporary ponum 9203 with a conservative spend band of $12,000/month. This is to allow BlueOcean to start integration without open-ended spend while legal and finance finish verification. ponum: P-9203 (temporary).

• Line items: We will accept the BLA-API-REG mapping as-is to API-L2 in the ledger, but the embedding line must be updated to EMB-L1-v2. I attached a short doc with instructions for how to resubmit the onboarding form and the fields we need populated to map to our catalog.

Next steps:
1) Claire: send W9 + corrected onboarding form to finance@redwood.inference.com (cc me)
2) BlueOcean: confirm you accept the temporary ponum P-9203 and the $12k/mo spend band
3) Connor: once W9 + corrected form are received, please apply final ponum and reassign line ownership if needed; update JIRA-PO-7412 with status.

Monica Patel
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Claire Burns <claire@blueocean.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: BlueOcean onboarding — provisional PO request

Monica — thanks for the quick turnaround. We accept the temporary ponum P-9203 and the $12k/month spend band. I uploaded the signed W9 to finance@redwood.inference.com and attached an updated onboarding form (v1.1) that maps our BLA-EMB-STD to EMB-L1-v2 as requested.

We expect initial usage ~ $6k this month so the cap is OK. We'll monitor and request an uplift once contracts are cleared.

Claire
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.inference.com>

Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:40:00 -0800

Connor — forwarding the thread. Please take ownership of the ledger updates and JIRA-PO-7412. Key asks: apply the temporary ponum P-9203 to BlueOcean's account, map BLA-API-REG -> API-L2 and BLA-EMB-STD -> EMB-L1-v2, and flag this for follow-up once finance clears the W9 so we can consider a spend uplift.
